title: Energy-ordered triangular inverse preserves hard legality

statement.quantifiers: Known finite D>=2, H>=0 with unique ground |0>, 0<E<=I and E|0>=|0>; EVERY n>=1,Q>=0.
statement.assertion: Order energy basis increasingly, E=Tdag T upper Cholesky,B=T^-1,P=1_[0,Q](sum_i H_i). Exact legal miss minimum p_n(Q)=||B^tensor n P||^-2. For any legal unit y, chi=B^tensor n y/||B^tensor n y|| is legal with that vector miss. Tilted norms/order thresholds are invariant under bases within degenerate energy blocks.
assumptions: Parallel zero-false-alarm pure-null test; no retained ancilla or adaptive interventions.
Hard support rho=P rho P; expected-energy ceiling is different.
Full rank E and unique ground; noninteracting sum Hamiltonian.

inputs: Explicit calibrated miss effect, energy eigenbasis and upper Cholesky factor.
outputs: Constrained many-copy optimization becomes tensor inverse-norm problem; legal constructive witness.
interface.precision: Exact algebra and cumulative energy support; small discarded norm may affect exponential miss.
costs: Accepted input legality does not give deterministic low-cost physical preparation.
Finite matrices supplied; unknown-channel calibration and scalable bit costs not covered.

proof_mechanism: Upper triangular T,B only lower energy basis indices; tensors preserve cumulative total-energy support.
Restricted T_P and B_P inverse; compressed effect T_Pdag T_P has minimum singular-value squared.
Block-upper unitary between Cholesky choices is block diagonal, commuting with H.
obstructions: Typical projection for -log E need not meet hard H support.
Additional vacuum slots reduce to at most floor(Q/hmin) excited sites, not hidden infinite input resource.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Find a support-preserving triangular factor for destination ordered resource; order alone is insufficient.

review.source_reported: Internal analytic audits or released-source proof only; exact reported scopes retained in cited source. No scientific suite or formal kernel replay in this extraction.
